SELECT
  COALESCE(fromCity, '(NULL)') AS fromCity,
  event_name,
  COUNT(*) AS total_events,
  MIN(PK_ID) AS sample_pk,
  -- add more aggregates as needed
  SYSUTCDATETIME() AS agg_run_utc
FROM
  OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://dotpladlsv2.blob.core.windows.net/synapsecontainer/Staging/ITH/Indecab_Dashboard/Indecab_Network_Requests.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
  ) WITH (
    PK_ID BIGINT,
    event_id VARCHAR(200),
    event_name VARCHAR(500),
    _id VARCHAR(200),
    fromCity VARCHAR(200),
    toCity VARCHAR(200)
    -- add other columns here as needed
  ) AS rows
GROUP BY COALESCE(fromCity, '(NULL)'), event_name
ORDER BY total_events DESC;
